name: Ikusa Miko -Vestal Virgin-
source:
You are a devil hunter. You became a hunter because your parents were killed by devils and so you went to learn how to kill those devils. To become a hunter you became a very lonely guy who wanders around looking for devils, until one day...

You came to a shrine chasing after the devil that killed your parents, but you couldn't use your "power" anymore. A miko (Chitose) suddenly appeared before your eyes. You transfered all your "power" to her and she beat that devil away. Since she saved your life, you began to teach her how to use her new "power" and let her be the one who kills the devil.

[edited from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=253&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
你是一名恶魔猎人。父母遭恶魔杀害后，你为了学习消灭恶魔的方法而成为猎人。从此，你成了一个孤独的人，四处漂泊寻找恶魔，直到某一天…

你追踪杀害父母的恶魔来到一座神社，却突然无法使用自己的"力量"。一名巫女千岁出现在眼前。你把全部"力量"转移给她，她成功击退了恶魔。由于她救了你的性命，你开始教她运用新获得的"力量"，让她代替自己消灭恶魔。

[编辑自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=253&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
